text: Yes, you have once again thwarted the threat of a Chaos invasion. Savor this brief moment of victory. Your Cathayan allies will rejoice on your account, while your Chaos foes will hate you all the more!

The Chaos hordes beyond the Great Bastion have gathered with unprecedented might. A Celestial Official, through a subtle and arcane rite, caught a fleeting glimpse of the future — 'Heaven and earth shall shatter, the throne shall crumble, the Great Bastion shall be broken, and all things shall turn to ash.' Utterly convinced of this vision, he rushed from his study, proclaiming the coming doom at the top of his voice. Before the Raven Guard could seize him, far too many of Cathay's people had already been crushed by dread of the apocalypse.

A crimson baleful star hangs in the sky, its glow visible even at high noon. All who dare gaze upon this ominous star fall into madness, and at last the Dragon Princes were forced to issue an unprecedented 'Edict of No Gazing' to bring the matter under control.
Cathay's allies are heartened by your feats against Chaos.
The champions of the Four Gods eagerly seek to earn glory by defeating you.
'Heaven and earth shall shatter, the throne shall crumble, the Great Bastion shall be broken, and all things shall turn to ash'? You silently mull over these words...
That baleful star spins endlessly before your eyes, as if it were the gaze of a blood-red god...
A Chaos army has been defeated, easing the pressure beyond the Great Bastion.
After brutal and bloody strife, a powerful new leader has once again risen from the Kurgan steppes. Now his hordes are massing, and he burns with ambition to surpass the deeds of Azazel Kul.

Great Bastion Threat: %+n% per region per turn in the province\\nThis effect only applies in the Northern Provinces (including Sulphur Road, Rockpeak Plains, Capital Circuit, Eastern Steppes, and the Red Wastes)

Any attempt to reunify Cathay's strength draws the wary attention of Chaos. Each Cathayan provincial capital captured increases Great Bastion Threat by +2% per turn.\\n\\nWhen the threat level grows too high, judicious use of the Five Phases Compass (directed at the Great Bastion) and the Dragon General's Decree can effectively reduce the threat.
